paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Ask what the customer needs: product, quantity, quality, delivery and payment date.
paragraphs.currentSesothoDraft: Botsa hore moreki o hloka eng: sehlahiswa, bongata, boleng, ho tliswa le letsatsi la tefo.
paragraphs.candidateSesotho: Botsa hore moreki o hloka eng: sehlahiswa, bongata, boleng, ho tliswa le letsatsi la tefo.
paragraphs.independentBacktranslation: Ask what the customer needs: product, quantity, quality, delivery and payment date.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Compare market fees, transport, packing and unsold produce as well as the selling price.
paragraphs.currentSesothoDraft: Compare market fees, transport, packing and unsold produce as well as the selling price.
paragraphs.candidateSesotho: Bapisa market fees, transport, packing and unsold produce, hammoho le selling price.
paragraphs.independentBacktranslation: Compare market fees, transport, packing and unsold produce, along with the selling price.
paragraphs.conditionsAndUncertainty: Cost categories and selling-price comparison remain exact English; backcheck Sesotho conjunction and comparison framing.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Check the market rules and local trading and food requirements. An informal stall does not automatically have no rules or costs.
paragraphs.currentSesothoDraft: Check the market rules and local trading and food requirements. An informal stall does not automatically have no rules or costs.
paragraphs.candidateSesotho: Hlahloba market rules and local trading and food requirements. An informal stall does not automatically have no rules or costs.
paragraphs.independentBacktranslation: Check market rules and local trading and food requirements. An informal stall does not automatically have no rules or costs.
paragraphs.conditionsAndUncertainty: Only the checking verb is translated. Keep local trade/food requirements and the informal-stall no-rules/no-cost caveat exact English.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Direct selling can retain more of the sale price, but it also takes time, packing, transport and customer care.
paragraphs.currentSesothoDraft: Direct selling can retain more of the sale price, but it also takes time, packing, transport and customer care.
paragraphs.candidateSesotho: Direct selling can retain more of the sale price, but it also takes time, packing, transport and customer care.
paragraphs.independentBacktranslation: Direct selling can retain more of the selling price, but it also requires time, packing, transport and customer care.
paragraphs.conditionsAndUncertainty: Independent backcheck found comparative or reliable-supply ambiguity; root keeps the complete precise English sentence.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: A box scheme supplies a regular selection to agreed customers.
paragraphs.currentSesothoDraft: Mokgwa wa mabokose o fa bareki ba dumellaneng kgetho ya dihlahiswa kgafetsa.
paragraphs.candidateSesotho: Mokgwa wa mabokose o fa bareki ba dumellaneng kgetho ya dihlahiswa kgafetsa.
paragraphs.independentBacktranslation: A box scheme supplies a regular selection to agreed customers.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Agree the contents, price, payment and what happens when crops are short. Regular orders help planning only when customers and growers can keep the agreement.
paragraphs.currentSesothoDraft: Agree the contents, price, payment and what happens when crops are short. Regular orders help planning only when customers and growers can keep the agreement.
paragraphs.candidateSesotho: Dumellanang ka contents, price, payment and what happens when crops are short. Regular orders help planning only when customers and growers can keep the agreement.
paragraphs.independentBacktranslation: Agree the contents, price, payment and what happens when crops are short. Regular orders help planning only when customers and growers can keep the agreement.
paragraphs.conditionsAndUncertainty: Contract terms, short-crop contingency, and condition on orders helping planning remain exact English.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Start from what you can reliably supply and what customers want.
paragraphs.currentSesothoDraft: Start from what you can reliably supply and what customers want.

paragraphs.independentBacktranslation: Start with what you can reliably supply and what customers want.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Check the costs and household food needs before promising regular boxes.
paragraphs.currentSesothoDraft: Check the costs and household food needs before promising regular boxes.
paragraphs.candidateSesotho: Sheba costs le ditlhoko tsa dijo tsa lelapa pele o tshepisa regular boxes.
paragraphs.independentBacktranslation: Check costs and household food needs before promising regular boxes.
paragraphs.conditionsAndUncertainty: Preserves costs and household food needs before promising regular boxes; ordinary household wording is translated, costs and regular boxes retained English.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Garden area or customer count alone does not predict income. Try a manageable arrangement and record the results.
paragraphs.currentSesothoDraft: Garden area or customer count alone does not predict income. Try a manageable arrangement and record the results.
paragraphs.candidateSesotho: Garden area or customer count alone does not predict income. Leka arrangement e ka laolehang mme o record results.
paragraphs.independentBacktranslation: Garden area or customer count alone does not predict income. Try an arrangement that can be managed and record results.
paragraphs.conditionsAndUncertainty: No-income-prediction safeguard remains exact English; ordinary trial-and-record instruction is translated.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: If production changes from week to week, avoid promising a fixed delivery you cannot supply.
paragraphs.currentSesothoDraft: Ha tlhahiso e fetoha beke le beke, qoba ho tshepisa phano e tsitsitseng eo o ke keng wa e fana.
paragraphs.candidateSesotho: Ha tlhahiso e fetoha beke le beke, qoba ho tshepisa phano e tsitsitseng eo o ke keng wa e fana.
paragraphs.independentBacktranslation: If production changes from week to week, avoid promising a fixed delivery you cannot supply.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Offer the surplus you have and agree clear terms with customers.
paragraphs.currentSesothoDraft: Offer the surplus you have and agree clear terms with customers.
paragraphs.candidateSesotho: Fana ka surplus eo o nang le yona, mme le dumellane ka terms tse hlakileng le bareki.
paragraphs.independentBacktranslation: Offer the surplus you have and agree clear terms with customers.
paragraphs.conditionsAndUncertainty: Surplus and clear-terms action translated; backcheck that “se setseng” preserves surplus and agreement framing.

paragraphs.sourceEnglish: Describe your growing practices honestly. Check any certification or claim the buyer requires before using a label.
